expectations.assertion: Explains that verify-published compared the fresh build against an older published artifact because publish was skipped
expectations.reason: The agent says the skipped publish means the registry still holds an earlier tarball, which verify-published downloads and compares against the fresh build from this run.

expectations.assertion: Prescribes that verify-published be gated on the same publish-decision output as the publish job
expectations.reason: The agent suggests gating on the publish job's result (`needs.publish.result == 'success'`) rather than on the same publish-decision output the publish job uses, so it does not match the prescribed gate.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT propose retrying the run or relaxing the comparison as the fix
expectations.reason: The agent proposes comparing content instead of bytes and ignoring mtimes and gzip headers as an option, which is a relaxation of the comparison, so the prohibition is not respected.

expectations.assertion: States the general rule: no post-publish verification may run in a no-publish run
expectations.reason: The agent offers skipping verification as the usual choice but never states the general rule that no post-publish verification may run in a no-publish run, and it also suggests verifying in the skipped case.
